summary: Defines the Autonomic Control Plane (ACP), a self-managing, largely configuration-independent control plane intended for autonomic functions. It supplies the addressing and routing those functions need to communicate, and can also serve as a stable management channel.

eli5.summary: A private, self-organizing back channel inside a network, always available for devices to talk to each other, even if normal settings are broken.

questions: what is the autonomic control plane
